changes: Uses less CPU in the audio engine, most of all while the tempo keeps moving, as with an external MIDI clock. Loops play exactly as in 0.3.0.
Known issue: a length of 3 to 16 BAR on a sample shorter than about 0.14 s can freeze the unit; use AUTO or a shorter length for such samples.
FUNC + TUN now offers 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 and 16 bars; AUTO still picks 1/4 to 16 in powers of two.
FUNC + FIN corrects by up to 25 % in 0.2 % steps.
Mode and correction are kept per sample (up to 51); FUNC + TUN/FIN always set the loop the sound loads.
A SMP-locked loop with no setting plays at the main loop's speed if it is a copy, else in AUTO; past TUN's range a loop no longer jumps back to full speed.
Settings saved with 0.2 are not read: set your loops again once.
First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on core-ar2 0.3: keeps sample loops in time with the project tempo by repitching them.
AUTO reads each loop's tempo from its length, SMP locks and scenes included; FUNC + FIN corrects each sample slot in percent.
Trailing digital silence is left out and the pitch glides on tempo changes. Pitch follows tempo: there is no time-stretch.
Not yet tested on a unit: this exact build, saving and reboots, external MIDI clock and CPU load.
